title: This release can't be installed with this installer
body: This release's system image keeps no place for your answers, so a phone installed from it by this installer would start with no account and nothing to unlock it with. This installer does not install such a release.
The installer that comes with the release ("install", run in a terminal) puts the answers on the phone itself; or use a newer release, from https://omamobile.org/download.
footer: Nothing was sent to a phone.
Starting the installer again as things are will stop here again.
